children: , the CPU and AI-accelerator designer, slipped about 2.0% to $611.426 Wednesday morning, two days after crossing the $1 trillion valuation mark. That milestone put AMD among a small group of chipmakers. Now comes the harder part: earning the valuation.

The pitch goes beyond selling processors. AMD's Helios platform combines accelerators, server CPUs, networking and software into a complete AI system. That gives AMD a shot at a bigger share of each customer's spending, while raising the bar for delivery and support.

The valuation gap is stark: the image puts AMD's GF Value at $284.34, with the $611.426 share price 115.03% higher. Investors are paying for the prospect of large-scale deployments and strong margins. The trillion-dollar milestone shows how much they expect; it does not show that AMD has delivered it yet.

title: AMD Falls 2% After AI Carries It Past $1 Trillion
